hints.title: BST Value Guided Descent
hints.text: Navigate down the tree toward the target, updating the closest recorded value at each step.

hints.title: Binary Descent and Tie-Breaking
hints.text: Compare difference with target. On ties, choose the smaller integer value. Branch left if target is smaller, else branch right.

hints.title: Single-Branch Path Search
hints.text: Initialize closest = root.val. While curr is not null, update closest if abs(curr.val - target) is less than abs(closest - target) or if tied and curr.val < closest. If target < curr.val, move left; else move right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: H: height of binary search tree
complexity.notes: Optimal single-path descent running in O(H) time and O(1) space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing the entire tree with inorder search takes O(N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Taking advantage of binary search tree ordering prunes subtrees at each comparison.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle tie-breaking by choosing the smaller value and descend in O(1) space.
